block.createpowertrain.physical_fire_hos: A flexible fluid line with _physical simulation_ and a _black_ default appearance.
Connecting endpoints
Place two matching endpoints in succession, or use a hose item on each endpoint. Both ends must have the same size.
Adjusting or disconnecting
A _Wrench_ cycles 8 / 6 / 4 on both ends. _Shears_ disconnect the hose. _Sneak-use_ a hose item to clear an existing selection; without a selection, sneak-use places an adjacent endpoint.
Connecting pipes
Connect pipes to the back of the endpoints. An external _pump_ drives fluid through the hose.
Hiding the tube
Apply a _Phantom Membrane_ to hide the flexible tube, or _Black Dye_ to restore it.

block.createpowertrain.copycat_physical_: A physical hose with _separate copycat materials_ for its tube and ports.
Use a block on the _centre of the outward face_ to fill the tube, or on the _rim or sides_ to fill the port. Each part accepts its own material.
Wrench a part to recover its material, or an empty part to resize. Use the same block again to cycle material states, including lit/unlit and orientation. Only the initial fill consumes an item.
Connected ends share one tube material; ports remain independent. An extra tube material applied before connecting is returned at the other endpoint.
Place two matching endpoints in succession, or use a hose item on each endpoint. Both ends must have the same size.
Wrench an unfilled part to change size. _Shears_ disconnect; _sneak-use_ a hose item to clear an existing selection; without a selection, sneak-use places an adjacent endpoint.
Connect pipes to the back of the endpoints. An external _pump_ drives fluid through the hose.

Glowing materials illuminate the area _around each endpoint_, using the brighter of the shared tube material and that port's material. Use the same material again to toggle a lamp. The tube between endpoints remains visually emissive.
A Create _belt_ fills only the tube body, never a port, consumes one, and shows the default _black_ hose material. _Wrench_ it to recover the belt, and repeat use costs nothing.
